_comment: Copy to .groundwork/guardrails.json (repo, team-shared) or ~/.claude/groundwork/guardrails.json (global). Effective mode = max(global/override, repo) per rule, off < ask < block, so the repo file can only tighten (raise) a rule, never loosen it; loosening comes only from the global file or $GROUNDWORK_GUARDRAILS_CONFIG. Every field is optional. See README 'Configure'.
